description: Update a page's WordPress category, author, or post link. Use to (a) override the auto-assigned category/author or (b) attach a manually-created WordPress post via wordpress_post_id so redirect export can map it. Set any field to null to clear.

author_id.description: WordPress author ID to assign (null to clear)

category_id.description: WordPress category ID to assign (null to clear)

wordpress_post_id.description: Manually link this page to an existing WordPress post ID. Sets posted_to_wordpress=true. Null to clear.

wordpress_post_url.description: WordPress post URL (paired with wordpress_post_id). Null to clear.

name: update_page
